title: S7: Macro-F1, per-class recall, confusion matrix and paired bootstrap
description:
## Purpose

Metrics fit for an imbalanced 6-class test set.

## Scope

In `unified_stats.py`: macro-F1 (primary), accuracy, per-class recall, confusion matrix, top-label Brier/ECE (document validity for N classes), paired bootstrap over macro-F1; optional prior-corrected readout using public train-split frequencies (pre-declared diagnostic, no held-out data).

## Specs (first, beside the module)

macro-F1 and recall match hand-computed cases incl. an absent class; confusion matrix shape N x N; bootstrap seed-stable; Brier/ECE top-label definition.

## Reuse

existing `unified_stats.py` helpers.

## Definition of done

Specs against hand-computed values pass; planted summaries unchanged.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
